text: crd_aud_write() extracted 9 citation rows 2 chapters. crd_aud_verify_all() searched source document best-matching passage. crd_aud_verify_abstract() handled row file. crd_aud_score() assigned review priority. Reading results: auto (yellow) — passage found, score >= threshold. Compare paraphrase vs quote — notice wording differs facts match. no_match (green) — Pacific Salmon Treaty row cites smith2020SalmonHabitat, freshwater habitat paper nothing harvest allocation. core failure mode cred surfaces: real key, plausible prose, wrong source. abstract_match (blue) — doe2021NoFile PDF, Zotero abstract confirms citation right domain. strong auto. Score 1 = suspect (no_match, numbers don’t appear quote). Score 4–5 = strong match. Review low scores first.

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: Create scripts/citation_audit.R – one file (LLM) run every time. handles first run vs. update automatically: Run full pipeline adding new citations attaching new PDFs Zotero. Run just quick update editing existing text:
code: # scripts/citation_audit.R -- repeatable citation audit pipeline library(cred)  audit_file <- "qa/citation_audit.csv"  # Step 1 -- Extract or update citations from Rmd chapters if (file.exists(audit_file)) {   crd_aud_upd(audit_file) } else {   crd_aud_write(out_file = audit_file) }  # Step 2 -- Resolve inline R (run from session with project variables loaded) # source("scripts/packages.R"); source("scripts/functions.R")  # if needed crd_aud_eval_inline(audit_file)  # Step 3 -- Auto-fill quotes from Zotero source files crd_aud_verify_all(audit_file)  # Step 4 -- Abstract fallback for NA rows crd_aud_verify_abstract(audit_file)  # Step 5 -- Score for review priority crd_aud_score(audit_file)  # Step 6 -- Summary crd_aud_summary(audit_file) # Quick -- re-extract and re-score only (seconds, no Zotero lookup) crd_aud_upd("qa/citation_audit.csv") crd_aud_score("qa/citation_audit.csv")

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: PDF/docx matching abstract matching use token overlap algorithm: Strip inline R, @citekeys, markdown punctuation paraphrase Extract word tokens (>= 4 characters) numeric tokens separately – numbers discriminative signals Score paragraph: proportion query tokens found passage Accept top-scoring passage score >= min_score (default 0.2) 0.2 means: 1 5 query tokens must appear passage. title: Extract the sentence(s) containing a specific citation key — crd_sent_ext_key
text: Split rules (applied outside [...] citation bracket groups): . [Capital] — period followed capital letter, excluding common abbreviations (et al., Dr., Mr., St.). . @key — period followed narrative citation, sentences form @author documented... correctly isolated. lookahead (?![^[]*\]) prevents splitting inside [@k1; @k2] checking ] reachable without first crossing [.

title: Extract the sentence(s) containing a specific citation key — crd_sent_ext_key
code: line <- paste(   "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y.",   "@brown2022 extended the finding." ) crd_sent_ext_key(line, "jones2021") #> [1] "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y." crd_sent_ext_key(line, "brown2022") #> [1] "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y. @brown2022 extended the finding."
